projects.summary: Originally planned for November, accelerated to now due to leadership interest. Data team conversation (Fri) suggests much of the groundwork may already exist -- possible quick win. Needs scoping to confirm effort.

projects.name: Methodology Narrative (Layer 2)
projects.summary: Synced with Andrea; continued building Layer 3, making the customer-facing page bolder and answering more questions. Filled-out master fed to Cesca to check — last step before finalising the master that feeds Layer 3 (client FAQs targeted end of month). Started the design brief for visuals, video, and brand guideline to add to the recently built client page.

projects.name: Project Garry
projects.summary: Post-launch adoption ramping: heavy run of 1:1s supporting teams onto Garry. 40 proposals created since launch, 4 customers have clicked into/viewed their proposal, and one client booked a follow-up meeting directly via the CTA. New since launch: simplified SMB proposal format, simplified packaging for the team, and continued roadmap/next-steps work plus one-pagers with Laila.

projects.name: What do to with trends
projects.summary: Faltam profissionais para analisar criticamente as tendências e criar algo novo a partir delas. O Programa Trendhackers foi criado para identificar as dores das marcas em relação às tendências e sistematizar um pensamento estratégico para impulsionar resultados de negócios. A WGSN oferece inteligência de previsão para ajudar as equipes a construir produtos com sucesso, decodificando sinais culturais e comportamentais dos consumidores. Com o lançamento do Trend Forecast Database, as estratégias são criadas para garantir o sucesso no mercado em rápida mudança.

projects.name: Trend Confirmations
projects.summary: Redesigned this week as a byproduct of Garry, Accuracy, and Methodology work — landed really well with Cesca and David, and already in use on the Nestlé document. Presenting to Wendy next week.
